# tcrdistR

C++-accelerated TCR distance calculations for T-cell receptor repertoire
analysis. Computes pairwise TCRdist distances incorporating V-region and
CDR3 sequence comparisons using BLOSUM62-derived substitution matrices.
Supports paired alpha-beta and single-chain (beta-only or alpha-only)
input, per-component distance decomposition, and targets feature parity
with Python [tcrdist3](https://github.com/kmayerb/tcrdist3).

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("shihanli92/tcrdistR")
```

## Quick Start

``` r
library(tcrdistR)
data(dash)

# Build a TCRrep object (deduplicates identical clones per subject)
rep <- TCRrep(dash, organism = "mouse", compute_distances = TRUE)
rep
#> TCRrep with 1888 clones (mouse, AB chains)
#>   paired_dist: 1888 x 1888

# Pairwise distance heatmap
plot_tcrdist_heatmap(rep@paired_dist[1:40, 1:40])

# Per-component distances (CDR3-only, V-region-only, etc.)
d_cdr3 <- tcrdist_matrix(rep@clone_df, "mouse", components = "cdr3")
d_v    <- tcrdist_matrix(rep@clone_df, "mouse", components = "v_region")

# Single-chain mode (beta-only input, no alpha columns needed)
beta_only <- rep@clone_df[, c("vb", "cdr3b")]
d_beta <- tcrdist_matrix(beta_only, "mouse")

# Kernel PCA
pca <- compute_tcrdist_kernel_pca(
  rep@clone_df, rep@organism, n_components = 50L
)
plot_tcr_scatter(
  pca$embeddings[, 1:2],
  color_by = rep@clone_df$epitope,
  title = "Kernel PCA",
  point_size = 1.5
)

# UMAP (uses TCRdist KNN neighbors directly)
umap <- compute_tcrdist_umap(rep@clone_df, rep@organism, seed = 42)
plot_tcr_scatter(
  umap$embeddings,
  color_by = rep@clone_df$epitope,
  axis_label_prefix = "UMAP",
  point_size = 1.5
)
```

## Documentation

Full reference and vignettes at
**<https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/>**.

- [`vignette("tcrdistR-getting-started")`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/articles/tcrdistR-getting-started.md)
  – Installation and core functions

  – Visualization guide

# Package index

## TCRrep Object

S4 class and constructor for TCR repertoire data

- [`TCRrep-class`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/TCRrep-class.md)
  : TCRrep S4 class
- [`TCRrep()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/TCRrep.md)
  : Create a TCRrep object
- [`show(`*`<TCRrep>`*`)`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/show-TCRrep-method.md)
  : Show method for TCRrep objects

## Distance Computation

Pairwise TCRdist distance calculations

- [`tcrdist_matrix()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_matrix.md)
  : Compute pairwise TCRdist distance matrix

- [`tcrdist_rect()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_rect.md)
  : Compute rectangular TCRdist matrix between a query set and a
  reference set

- [`tcrdist_sparse()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_sparse.md)
  :

  Compute sparse TCRdist matrix as a `dgCMatrix`

- [`weighted_cdr3_distance()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/weighted_cdr3_distance.md)
  : Weighted CDR3 distance between two CDR3 sequences

- [`bsd4_matrix()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/bsd4_matrix.md)
  : Retrieve the BSD4 substitution matrix

- [`hamming_distance()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/hamming_distance.md)
  : Hamming distance between two CDR3 sequences

- [`hamming_matrix()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/hamming_matrix.md)
  : Pairwise Hamming distance matrix for CDR3 sequences

## Neighbor Search

K-nearest neighbor and radius-based neighbor queries

- [`tcrdist_knn()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_knn.md)
  : K-nearest-neighbors by TCRdist with optional group masking
- [`tcrdist_radius_neighbors()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_radius_neighbors.md)
  : Radius-based TCRdist neighbor search with optional group masking
- [`knn_from_matrix()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/knn_from_matrix.md)
  : K-nearest-neighbors from a precomputed distance matrix
- [`knn_from_pca()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/knn_from_pca.md)
  : K-nearest-neighbors from a PCA embedding matrix

## Clumping & Background Models

TCR clumping detection with background-corrected significance

- [`find_clumping()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/find_clumping.md)
  : Find TCR clumping in TCR space
- [`setup_tcr_groups()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/setup_tcr_groups.md)
  : Assign alpha and beta chain group indices

## Database Matching

Match TCRs against literature epitope databases

- [`find_significant_tcrdist_matches()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/find_significant_tcrdist_matches.md)
  : Find significant TCRdist matches between query and database TCRs
- [`match_tcrs_to_db()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/match_tcrs_to_db.md)
  : Match TCRs to a literature database
- [`strict_single_chain_match_tcrs_to_db()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/strict_single_chain_match_tcrs_to_db.md)
  : Strict CDR3 sequence matching against a database

## Dimensionality Reduction

Kernel PCA and UMAP for TCRdist distance matrices

- [`compute_tcrdist_kernel_pca()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/compute_tcrdist_kernel_pca.md)
  : Kernel PCA on TCRdist distances
- [`compute_tcrdist_umap()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/compute_tcrdist_umap.md)
  : Compute UMAP embedding from TCRdist data

## CD8 Scoring

Logistic regression-based CD8 phenotype scoring

- [`make_cd8_score_table_column()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/make_cd8_score_table_column.md)
  : CD8 logistic regression score for paired TCRs

## Diversity Metrics

Repertoire diversity, richness, and clonality

- [`tcr_diversity()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcr_diversity.md)
  : Generalized Simpson's diversity (Hill numbers framework)
- [`tcr_fuzzy_diversity()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcr_fuzzy_diversity.md)
  : TCR-aware fuzzy diversity
- [`tcr_richness()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcr_richness.md)
  : TCR repertoire richness
- [`tcr_clonality()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcr_clonality.md)
  : TCR repertoire clonality

## Clustering & Neighborhood Tests

Hierarchical clustering and neighborhood-based statistics

- [`tcrdist_hclust()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_hclust.md)
  : Hierarchical clustering of TCRs by TCRdist
- [`cluster_tcrs()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/cluster_tcrs.md)
  : Cluster TCRs by TCRdist-based hierarchical clustering
- [`neighborhood_test()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/neighborhood_test.md)
  : Test association between a variable and TCR neighborhoods

## Meta-Clonotypes

Quasi-public TCR motif discovery across subjects

- [`find_meta_clonotypes()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/find_meta_clonotypes.md)
  : Identify quasi-public meta-clonotypes
- [`summarize_meta_clonotype()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/summarize_meta_clonotype.md)
  : Summarize a meta-clonotype's composition

## Joins

Distance-based fuzzy joining of TCR datasets

- [`tcrdist_join()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/tcrdist_join.md)
  : Join two TCR datasets by TCRdist threshold

## Visualization

Plotting functions for TCR repertoire data

- [`plot_tcrdist_heatmap()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_tcrdist_heatmap.md)
  : Plot a TCRdist pairwise distance heatmap
- [`plot_tcrdist_dendrogram()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_tcrdist_dendrogram.md)
  : Plot a TCRdist-based dendrogram
- [`plot_distance_distribution()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_distance_distribution.md)
  : Plot the distribution of pairwise TCRdist distances
- [`plot_cdr3_logo()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_cdr3_logo.md)
  : Plot a CDR3 sequence logo
- [`plot_junction_bars()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_junction_bars.md)
  : Plot junction bars showing V/N/D/J nucleotide composition
- [`plot_gene_usage()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_gene_usage.md)
  : Plot V-gene or J-gene usage frequencies
- [`plot_tcr_scatter()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_tcr_scatter.md)
  : Plot a 2D scatter of TCR embeddings
- [`compute_tcr_network()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/compute_tcr_network.md)
  : Build a TCR clone network from distance data
- [`plot_tcr_network()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/plot_tcr_network.md)
  : Plot a TCR clone network

## I/O

Read and standardize TCR data from various formats

- [`as_tcr_df()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/as_tcr_df.md)
  : Standardize a TCR data.frame to tcrdistR column names
- [`read_tcr_table()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/read_tcr_table.md)
  : Read a delimited file containing TCR repertoire data
- [`read_airr()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/read_airr.md)
  : Read AIRR Rearrangement TSV format
- [`read_adaptive()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/read_adaptive.md)
  : Read Adaptive Biotechnologies ImmunoSeq TSV file
- [`read_10x()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/read_10x.md)
  : Read 10X Genomics VDJ contig annotations

## Data

Built-in datasets

- [`dash`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/dash.md) :
  DASH dataset: paired alpha-beta mouse TCRs across 7 epitopes

## Utilities

Gene database, constants, and helper functions

- [`load_gene_database()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/load_gene_database.md)
  : Load and cache the TCR/BCR gene database
- [`trim_allele_to_gene()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/trim_allele_to_gene.md)
  : Trim allele designation from a gene ID
- [`get_translation()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/get_translation.md)
  : Translate a nucleotide sequence to a protein sequence
- [`reverse_complement()`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/reverse_complement.md)
  : Reverse complement of a nucleotide sequence
- [`AMINO_ACIDS`](https://shihanli92.github.io/tcrdistR/reference/AMINO_ACIDS.md)
  : Standard 20 amino acid single-letter codes
